name: Bug Reproduction
tagline: Turns a report into a staging repro pack a human can file from.
description: Grok Bot profile from awesome-grokbot. Reads a GitHub issue or Slack report and returns steps, expected vs actual, screenshots, and a minimal case. Draft only. Does not comment on the issue unless asked.

install.command: Paste this SETUP.md URL as the first message in a new Grok Bot chat.

author: mergisi
notes: Do not use production customer data.
